capabilities.name: document.processing
capabilities.description: Document handling at the RIP/processor boundary, separate from physical equipment.

live_transparency.description: Preserves supported transparency in this configuration.

capabilities.name: document.acceptance
capabilities.description: Accepts declared document-format identifiers. Acceptance does not recognize, preserve, or interpret document semantics.

input_formats.description: Accepted format identifiers, such as pdf-x-4.

document_profiles.description: Accepted profile identifiers within the declared formats.

capabilities.name: document.feature_recognition
capabilities.description: Recognizes declared document features without claiming that they are retained or interpreted for production.

recognized_features.description: Recognizable features, such as processing_steps, technical_separations, live_transparency, or spot_colors.

capabilities.name: document.feature_preservation
capabilities.description: Preserves declared features through a document-processing boundary without claiming their production interpretation.

preserved_features.description: Features preserved by this configuration, such as processing_steps, technical_separations, live_transparency, or spot_colors.

processing_step_profiles.description: Named Processing Steps profiles preserved by this configuration.

capabilities.name: document.production_interpretation
capabilities.description: Interprets declared document semantics for an external production process. It neither provides a physical capability nor executes that process.

interpreted_features.description: Features interpreted for an external process, such as processing_steps or technical_separations.

processing_step_profiles.description: Named Processing Steps profiles that can be interpreted.
